sourceMeaning: revised Garak+Gangseo auction/kg signed-aggregate daily proxy; historical first-publication times unknown
excludedCrop: pepper: current project scope defers new pepper experiments
target: calendar dekad: days 1-10, 11-20, 21-month-end; arithmetic mean of actually observed positive daily proxy prices; at least 3 observed dates; no fill
issue: one origin per completed dekad, 10:00 KST on the second calendar day after its end; inputs through completed dekad end only; 2nd/3rd subsequent dekads are distinct targets
labelEligibility: at each fit, include only target periods ending at least two calendar days before fit origin; input features at historical issue cutoff; no final-test outcomes in model or setting selection

methods.B0a: latest observed daily price at issue cutoff
methods.B0b: latest completed valid dekad mean at issue cutoff
methods.B0c: same calendar dekad of preceding year when valid
methods.B1: direct crop-by-horizon StandardScaler+Ridge on log(target/latest-price), using historical daily price/volume summaries, past valid dekad price, age, known target-calendar distance/season; alpha in [1,10,100] chosen by development MAPE
methods.C1: B1 procedure plus one signed shift-to-expensive-market indicator from prior and recent 14-day nonoverlapping windows, market support and completeness indicators; same alpha grid; missing market feature uses prespecified B1 forecast fallback

development: rolling-origin predictions for 2022-2023; select one alpha per crop/horizon/method by development MAPE, tie lower alpha; strongest simple comparator per crop/horizon chosen among B0a/B0b/B0c only if >=30 unique target periods and >=90% of B0a-valid development keys, ranked by MAPE on the common keys with B0a, tie B0a then B0b then B0c; C1 attempted only if development B1 signed residual vs indicator has >=20 eligible unique target periods, positive Spearman >=0.1, and positive yearly correlations in 2022 and 2023
test: 2024-2026 target-period rolling-origin evaluation; fit each calendar quarter using all previously matured eligible labels, fixed selected alpha; compare on same issue/target keys and report method-specific issuance/target coverage
comparisonFamily: 4 crops x 2 horizons x 3 comparisons (B1 vs selected B0, C1 vs B1, C1 vs selected B0) x 2 losses (AE, APE) = 48; both unavailable/identical comparisons retained as inferentially unavailable
statistics: paired MAE/MAPE and DM mean loss difference; target-dekad index Bartlett HAC lag 3 primary and 6 sensitivity; two-sided p, Holm 5% separately per bandwidth across 48; minimum 30 distinct paired target periods and positive HAC variance; zero/insufficient/fallback-only explicitly inference unavailable; no equivalence claim from non-significance
reporting: observed difference, statistical superiority, and operational adoption are separate; improvement requires lower paired MAE and MAPE plus both primary Holm p<0.05 versus selected B0; C1 incremental improvement also requires both primary Holm p<0.05 versus B1; no operational adoption based on retrospective proxy; document all stop/fallback reasons, annual stability and coverage
limitations: not official 2026 period definition, national target, contest score, or prospective performance; prior analyses have inspected 2024-2026, so final test is exploratory even though this protocol is frozen before this run
